status: ready for preflight; no pilot training launched yet
initialization: fresh for both C and D; recovery model is a separate deployment reference
curriculum_promotion: fixed budget and last checkpoint within stages, preserving equal stage budgets

deployment_selection.rule: Same four predetermined candidates for each arm; select the lowest existing checkpoint_score only among candidates passing all stage-5 gates on held-out validation. No hardware-based selection and no silent gate-failure fallback.
candidates: first saved checkpoint at or after 25% of stage-5 updates
first saved checkpoint at or after 50% of stage-5 updates
deployment_selection.benchmark_condition: common range environment for all arms
deployment_selection.if_none_pass: record failed pilot arm with final-checkpoint metrics; do not omit it from the comparison or start multi-seed replication
deployment_selection.scenario_seeding: base seed plus canonical index in SCENARIOS; independently reset torch/Python RNG and recurrent state before each scenario

reporting.fixed_budget_final: retain and report final-checkpoint results as a separate comparison
reporting.selected_for_deployment: report selected iteration, validation score, gate results and hash; no mixing with final-checkpoint r2 averages
reporting.hardware: same firmware and motor settings, only generated policy changes; log exact model hash; repeated matched protocol, randomize arm order
reporting.old_r2: preserve all seeds including failed C42
reporting.replication: Keep the planned 42/43/44 comparison, with no seed removal. Seed 43 pilot is development data; disclose tuning and use separate held-out evaluation. Freeze protocol before seeds 42 and 44.

implementation_note: Implemented by scripts/tools/run_cd_pilot.sh, run_retrain_arms.sh optional pilot mode, and select_cd_pilot_checkpoint.py. Fixed last-checkpoint curriculum promotion; four predetermined post-training candidates; separate validation/test; failed arms keep final metrics and do not export. Stage-5 selected_checkpoint.json remains the fixed-budget final; deployment_selection.json records the held-out choice.
provenance: Commit the exact source, configuration and selection protocol before launch; archive resolved settings and model hashes. Preserve unrelated Paper and embedded Results work.
budget_rationale: Shortened pilot only: keep stages 1-4 unchanged, halve stage 5. This reduces updates by 10.7% versus r2; adequacy is provisional and must be assessed on frozen checkpoints, not training logs. No training launched.
